indicator_name: Damu Fund: loans approved for interest-rate subsidy by approval year, region, programme, ОКЭД section and business size
description: Фонд «Даму»: кредиты, одобренные к субсидированию ставки, по годам одобрения, регионам, программам, отраслям и размеру бизнеса
methodology: Sum of project rows of Damu's subsidy report (all programmes since 2010: ДКБ-2020/2025, Нацпроект, портфельное субсидирование, ПСЭ, ЕКП, ЭПВ, Іскер аймақ), dated by approval year. Items TOTAL, COUNT.TOTAL, PROG.*, SEC.<ОКЭД letter>, SIZE.*. Region = region of the project. Loans APPROVED for subsidy, not disbursements; the latest edition is a snapshot (cancelled projects drop out, earlier years get revised). Region totals checked against the file's summary sheet.
